title: OntologyPackSource
description: Verified library pack selection that a native ontology change set installs.

moduleIds.description: Selected modules with their dependencies, in catalogue order.

slice.description: Set when a library install job cut the pack into change sets. Applying the change set verifies its operations against the job's recorded plan.

jobId.description: Background job that planned this slice.

index.description: Zero-based position of this slice in the plan.

count.description: Number of slices in the plan.

planDigest.description: SHA-256 of the plan's ordered slice digests.
